Note: The english title is not official, its just a rough fan-translation.

This is largely the same gallery as the one posted previously (https://e-hentai.org/g/4043433/cddc196a78/). The difference is that this includes five images that were not included in the previous gallery. Four drawn by Mubo that are present in the files included when purchasing this work, and a larger, horizontally oriented version of the cover art (This was originally a jpg, but it was too large to be uploaded, so I converted it into a png). This gallery exists for completion's sake.

The second volume of the "Flesh Festival" (《肉祭榭》) series. It generally contains a lot of tentacle porn/rape on shotas. Which makes Mayozom's participation so much more ironic, as that artist NORMALLY makes a bunch of horror/body horror/violent stuff, but their work in this book is by far the most tame of the sequences included. (It is also Mayozom's first pornographic work that I know of?). Shout out to the artist of the image for pg. 92, Fino, a.k.a. NoFi, the artist of the Forest of Strangers (original Chinese title: "异人之森")

The images are organized as they appear in the download files of the work purchased from DLsite.
First, which are the images from pg.1-149 are from the "main" folder. The rest are bonus arts made by the artists you participated in the work.
pg. 150-163 is by Kabosu (an artist that regularly works with the group "Commamion")
pg. 164-173 is by Mayozom (a horror artist, this book contains their first published pornographic works I think?)
pg. 174-178 is by Mubo (the images in Mubo's folder were absent in the previously linked gallery)
pg. 179-194 is by Pepero

Note that the "bonus" images listed above may duplicates of other images present in the gallery.
